name: Sharavati

sink.name: Near Honnavar
sink.location: Uttara Kannada district, Karnataka, Arabian Sea

significance: hydropower (Jog Falls / Mahatma Gandhi Hydroelectric Station)
did_you_know: About 29 km from the sea, the Sharavati plunges roughly 250 metres to form Jog Falls, one of India's highest waterfalls, split into four cataracts.
By legend, the river's name comes from Shara ('arrow'): Rama is said to have shot an arrow into the ground here to summon water for Sita.
The Linganamakki Dam upstream of Jog Falls and the Mahatma Gandhi Hydroelectric Station just below it together supply a significant share of Karnataka's electricity.
